prospects.fitSummary: TACTIQL lets a reviewer assess FULCRUM's sensor-to-command data conditioning and Canadian Army validation through ised-isde.canada.ca, then compare NATO exercise maturity and coalition interoperability while preserving product-lineage, contract-scope and deployment limits.

Resolved KILO 1.0, KILO 2.0, employment and export-assistance records without combining them as revenue or product outcomes.
Confirmed NATO DIANA Phase 2 selection and separately retained the page's innovator-count discrepancy.
Confirmed a FULCRUM exercise demonstration but no independent performance result, acceptance or operational-fielding evidence.
Resolved Kongsberg and Calian announcements to durable partner pages and kept their forward-looking MOU and co-development limits.
Resolved the published Canadian patent application and assignee while avoiding a grant, enforceability or deployment claim.
The French ISED surface corroborated the same KILO test family and added no conflicting product, value or deployment fact.
Reviewed authenticated LinkedIn announcements, resolved durable NATO, Calian and Kongsberg events, and deferred three social-only claims lacking sufficient durable support.
